scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 16 boards of six live Deity Science (Online) games (civvis-20261105T215700Z, 154934Z, 103825Z, 133505Z, 211703Z, 125414Z), each the run's events.jsonl cut at frame 0 of a turn after Cartography with no sea hull of ours afloat. Both arms run one frozen civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch at 241b71f4f with the run's own requested genome (which carries contact-fleet); the on arm adds --with sea-scout-claims-the-queue. Orders differ in 12/16 reads and the claim ('starts <hull> for the contact fleet') is journaled in 12/16 on arms and 0/16 off arms. The four that do not fire: 211703Z's only coastal city made 2 Production on a Knight at t89 and already held a slow Quadrireme at t120, which the arm reads as being rebuilt; 125414Z t81 and t110 are unexplained. 215700Z t93 lays down a Caravel at Badung in 4.0 turns, where the live game started a Quadrireme at t104 quoted at 33.3 turns and launched it at t118.
